author: Peachiii
quote: What can I say? This game definitely reawakened the joy I felt for the first time when I played it as a child. They stayed quite close to the story and improved our graphics a ton! I've always loved the storyline and I think they tied everything together beautifully, not to mention the side quests and mini-games throughout were incredible! The dungeons are engaging and I really enjoy the puzzles in them, too. The bosses are impossible and the controls are VERY smooth. I also like that you can assign a couple buttons on your controller to customise it a little for yourself and your own ease. I can already see myself playing this game through several times over for a while.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

author: Peachiii
quote:
It's honestly nothing special. Clunky mechanics and, well, I don't personally find myself very willing to pick it up and spend hours playing it like I thought I would. I could have put my money to better use than buying this game, in my opinion. It's actually not too different from the previous titles, and I've been playing them all ever since GTA Vice City. Sure, graphics improved but I feel like the game was mostly a money grab. I feel like, for having had us wait so long, they could have done a lot more than they did. 

To add on: The online discourse is insane and, for whatever reason, the GTA community decided that no other game (looking at you, Zelda OOC Remake) should be allowed to come out at the same time or be as successful if not more. I got both, and honestly I prefer the graphics of the OOC Remake, the voice acting and the fact that they kept it very close to the classic.
